title: The Eight-Direction Fire Dragon
summary: Before the fight the Beast Deity asks Gui Li and Lu Xueqi for one thing if he loses: to pick a bunch of the lilies Ling Long loved and lay them before her statue at the cave mouth. When Lu Xueqi says she has no greater wish, he says there is still a woman in the world like Ling Long. He drinks with them as with true friends, then shows them the secret of Ling Long's own formation. The Eight-Direction Fire Dragon appears, and Hei Hu remembers Ling Long's dying words that when the dragon came back to this place, all the hatred and karma would end. Gui Li and Lu Xueqi fight side by side, she with the Divine Thunder of the Nine Heavens sword art. The cave starts to fall in. The dying Beast Deity sees Ling Long at last and goes to her, and Hei Hu goes gladly to join his goddess. Elsewhere, someone who had counted on the cave's formation diagram decides to look for surviving Wu clansmen instead. Gui Li and Lu Xueqi rest together, agreeing not to think about tomorrow, and keep the promise of the lilies, though the statue has likely crumbled; they take it that Ling Long has become one with the land she died to protect.
